citations.description: Ticket e759-c562-e233-4108 comment by RebarBotNava: FINAL RECOMMENDATION section uses prose/bullet categories, not a table. Text reads: 'Hard additions to clarity: exactly two — (A) nonempty parsed AC items and (B) unresolved sentinel assignments…Advisory only: preferred section presence/aliases, per-AC proof coverage, duplicate ACs…Other subsystem invariants: malformed present file-impact -> write validation; [rebar:id] edge checking -> grounding exception path only.'
Acceptance criterion text: 'The final recommendation clearly separates hard-floor rules from advisory signals, verified by a structured classification table in the final findings.'

findings.criterion: The final recommendation clearly separates hard-floor rules from advisory signals, verified by a structured classification table in the final findings.
findings.detail: The FINAL RECOMMENDATION section in the comment separates hard-floor rules from advisory signals in prose/bullet-list form, but the acceptance criterion explicitly requires a 'structured classification table.' The comment uses categorized prose ('Hard additions to clarity: exactly two — (A)… (B)…', 'Advisory only: …', 'Other subsystem invariants: …') rather than a tabular structure (e.g., a markdown table with rows per criterion and columns for classification). The format requirement is not satisfied.
findings.remediation: Add a markdown classification table to the findings comment with at minimum columns for Criterion #, Rule Name, and Classification (hard-floor / advisory / other-subsystem), one row per criterion under review.

data.remediation: How to resolve the unmet criteria: for each one, decide whether the work is genuinely incomplete or simply undocumented. If a requirement is already satisfied but the proof is not discoverable from the code alone, add a comment to this ticket that documents the evidence — cite the concrete artifacts that meet the requirement (file paths and line ranges, commands and their output, links, or the reasoning that ties the work to the criterion). The completion verifier reads this ticket's comments, so evidence you record there is taken into account on the next verification. For any criterion whose work is genuinely unfinished, complete it, then re-verify.
